description: Wire the full learning journey into real navigation with honest states: extract the shared focus reason->copy map, add the ProgressionProvider context + shared FinanceDisclaimerBanner/ScreenState components, expand RootNavigator to the full typed screen graph, author every journey screen reading real data (catalog/context/focus) with explicit loading/empty/error handling, wire the async root gate in App.tsx, and add render smoke tests of key screens. Depends on FEAT-002 (domain functions) and FEAT-003 (persistence/context). Design section 6 and the JS build smoke in 7.4. Replaces the Phase 1 placeholder Home screen.
steps: Create /Users/Shared/goalie/src/ui/focus/reasonText.ts exporting REASON_TEXT: Record<FocusUnavailableReason,string>, moved verbatim from the private map in src/ui/screens/HomeScreen.tsx (design 6.2 Focus). Keep the Record exhaustive over FocusUnavailableReason.

Create /Users/Shared/goalie/src/ui/context/ProgressionProvider.tsx (React context, UI-layer not domain) per design 6.1: performs the async loadData() on mount, holds the loaded Catalog + current ProgressionState + displayName + selectedTrackId, and exposes completeLesson/recordMasteryResult/deleteAllData wrappers that call the PURE domain functions then persist via saveData/clearData. It is the SINGLE place the UI touches persistence; screens never import AsyncStorage. deleteAllData: await clearData(), reset in-memory to defaultPersistedData(), route to TrackSelect; on failure surface an error and leave state untouched.

Create shared components /Users/Shared/goalie/src/ui/components/FinanceDisclaimerBanner.tsx (reads the track's disclaimer content field; always-visible, not dismissible) and /Users/Shared/goalie/src/ui/components/ScreenState.tsx (renders loading/empty/error consistently so no screen invents its own blank).

Expand /Users/Shared/goalie/src/ui/navigation/RootNavigator.tsx per design 6.1: define the full typed RootStackParamList (TrackSelect; Home; CoursePath{trackId}; Lesson/Practice/Result{trackId,levelId,lessonId}; Mastery/MasteryResult{trackId,levelId}; Progress; Focus; Certificate{trackId}; Settings) and register every screen. RootNavigator keeps ownership of RootStackParamList + NavigationContainer and accepts a computed initialRouteName prop; it does NOT call persistence itself.

Author the screens under /Users/Shared/goalie/src/ui/screens/ per design 6.2, each with its data source and honest loading/empty/error states: TrackSelect (lists catalog tracks + optional display name, persists selection -> Home); Home (ONE real next action derived from progression, or empty/error, never a fake action); CoursePath (per-level viewLevelProgress, published mastery.passRule, finance banner when finance); Lesson (renders objective/explanation/workedExample; not-found guard for bad lessonId); Practice (practice.prompt + reveal/self-check, no fake grading); Result (marks lesson complete via context on arrival = completion-by-reaching-Result, derives completion events, awaits the write and does not claim completion until it succeeds); Mastery (the 5 single-correct MCQs, requires all five answered before submit so gradeMastery never hits its length throw; finance banner); MasteryResult (gradeMastery -> correctCount/5 + per-question correctness + pass/fail vs >=4, recordMasteryResult, deriveCompletionEvents, Retry that never lowers progress); Progress (badges only when isLevelComplete; bestCorrectCount history; link to Certificate; empty state); Focus (getFocusAvailability() rendered honestly via shared REASON_TEXT; never a fake blocked/active state; loading/unavailable/available states); Certificate (buildCertificatePreview, clearly labeled 'Preview - not an official certificate; full PDF in a later release', only truly-earned levels, empty state); Settings (a11y-friendly labeled large-tap controls + local-data deletion with a destructive confirm -> deleteAllData -> TrackSelect; a failed delete surfaces an error and leaves state untouched). Replace the Phase 1 HomeScreen.tsx with the new Home (remove the old placeholder file / its private REASON_TEXT, now shared).

Wire /Users/Shared/goalie/App.tsx per design 6.1: wrap RootNavigator in ProgressionProvider and the async root gate -- render a neutral loading state while loadData() is pending, an error-with-retry if the native read rejects, then compute initialRouteName (TrackSelect if no track selected, else Home) and pass it to RootNavigator. Leave /Users/Shared/goalie/index.ts unchanged.

Add /Users/Shared/goalie/__tests__/screens.smoke.test.tsx using react-test-renderer@19.1.0 (already installed; do NOT add @testing-library/react-native). Mock AsyncStorage as in FEAT-003 where a screen pulls context state. Render at least: Focus (asserts honest unavailable state text from the shared REASON_TEXT, never a fake blocked/active state), a finance screen (asserts FinanceDisclaimerBanner renders text from the disclaimer field), and Progress (asserts a completion badge renders only when isLevelComplete is true). Assert each renders without throwing.
acceptance_criteria: npm run typecheck passes (strict) with the full screen graph, context, and components.

RootStackParamList enumerates all 12 routes with typed params and RootNavigator registers each; App.tsx mounts the navigator only after loadData() resolves with a computed initialRouteName (no navigator mounted against unresolved/fabricated state).
No screen imports AsyncStorage directly (only ProgressionProvider does); the old src/ui/screens/HomeScreen.tsx placeholder is replaced and REASON_TEXT lives only in src/ui/focus/reasonText.ts.

npx jest __tests__/screens.smoke.test.tsx passes: Focus shows the honest unavailable verdict (no fake blocking), the finance banner renders from the disclaimer field, and a badge renders only when isLevelComplete.
findings:
Full learning journey wired into real navigation with honest states. GREEN.

New/changed files:
- src/ui/focus/reasonText.ts: exports REASON_TEXT: Record<FocusUnavailableReason,string>, moved verbatim from the old private map in HomeScreen.tsx; exhaustive over the 5 reasons. REASON_TEXT now lives ONLY here (grep-confirmed).
- src/ui/context/ProgressionProvider.tsx: UI-layer React context, the SINGLE place the UI touches persistence. On mount parses the bundled catalog via loadCatalog(tracks.json) and awaits store.loadData(); holds status('loading'|'ready'|'error') + error + catalog + progression + displayName + selectedTrackId. Exposes reload(), setSelection(trackId,displayName), completeLesson(), recordMasteryResult(), deleteAllData(). completeLesson/recordMasteryResult call the PURE domain fns then persist via saveData (re-throws on write failure so callers can surface 'couldn't save'). deleteAllData awaits clearData() first, then resets memory to defaults; on failure it re-throws and leaves state untouched. useProgression() hook throws outside the provider. No screen imports AsyncStorage (grep-confirmed: zero async-storage imports under src/ui).
- src/ui/components/FinanceDisclaimerBanner.tsx (reads the track's disclaimer content field; always-visible, accessibilityRole alert, not dismissible) and src/ui/components/ScreenState.tsx (LoadingState/EmptyState/ErrorState so no screen invents its own blank; ErrorState carries an onRetry recovery action).
- src/ui/navigation/RootNavigator.tsx: full typed RootStackParamList with all 12 routes (TrackSelect; Home; CoursePath{trackId}; Lesson/Practice/Result{trackId,levelId,lessonId}; Mastery{trackId,levelId}; MasteryResult{trackId,levelId,answers:number[]} - answers carried so MasteryResult can gradeMastery; Progress; Focus; Certificate{trackId}; Settings) and registers every screen. Keeps ownership of NavigationContainer and accepts a computed initialRouteName prop; does NOT call persistence.
- src/ui/screens/: catalogLookup.ts (pure findTrack/findLevel/findLesson/isFinanceTrack helpers that return null, not throw, on bad params) + all journey screens per design 6.2. HomeScreen replaced with the real Home (one real next action derived from viewLevelProgress/isLevelComplete: resume incomplete lesson -> mastery -> next level -> certificate; empty/error states; never a fake action). TrackSelect persists selection->Home. CoursePath shows accurate viewLevelProgress + published mastery.passRule + finance banner. Lesson/Practice/Result (Result marks the lesson complete via context on arrival = completion-by-reaching-Result, awaits the write, shows 'couldn't save - retry' on failure and does NOT claim completion, derives completion events for a level-complete moment). Mastery (5 single-correct MCQs, requires all five answered before submit so gradeMastery never hits its length throw). MasteryResult (gradeMastery -> correctCount/5 + per-question correctness + pass/fail vs MASTERY_PASS_THRESHOLD, recordMasteryResult, deriveCompletionEvents, Retry that never lowers progress). Progress (badges ONLY when isLevelComplete; bestCorrectCount history; link to Certificate; empty state). Focus (getFocusAvailability() rendered honestly via shared REASON_TEXT; loading/unavailable/available; never a fake blocked/active state, never starts a session). Certificate (buildCertificatePreview, labeled 'Preview - not an official certificate; full PDF in a later release', only truly-earned levels, empty state). Settings (large-tap labeled controls + destructive Alert confirm -> deleteAllData -> navigation.reset to TrackSelect; a failed delete surfaces an error and leaves state untouched).
- App.tsx: wraps the tree in ProgressionProvider + a RootGate (loading state while pending, error-with-retry if the native read rejects, then RootNavigator with computed initialRouteName = TrackSelect if selectedTrackId is null else Home). index.ts left unchanged (git diff empty).
- __tests__/screens.smoke.test.tsx (react-test-renderer@19.1.0, AsyncStorage official mock): Focus asserts an honest unavailable reason from the shared REASON_TEXT and NO fabricated blocked/blocking/session-active text; CoursePath{personal-finance} asserts the FinanceDisclaimerBanner renders the disclaimer field text; Progress asserts 'Beginner complete' badge renders ONLY when the beginner level is isLevelComplete (both lessons + mastery passed) and is absent otherwise. Each renders without throwing.
- types/react-test-renderer.d.ts: minimal ambient module types (create/act/ReactTestRenderer) so strict typecheck passes WITHOUT adding @types/react-test-renderer or @testing-library/react-native (outside the pinned matrix); placed in a new types/ dir (added to tsconfig include) rather than __tests__ so jest does not treat it as a suite.

Verification (from /Users/Shared/goalie): `npm run typecheck` clean (strict); `npm run lint` 0 errors (2 warnings are the mandated require()-in-jest.mock official-AsyncStorage-mock pattern, same convention accepted in FEAT-003); `npx jest __tests__/screens.smoke.test.tsx` => 1 suite / 4 tests passed; full `npm test` => 8 suites / 56 tests passed. Native code unchanged this phase (no xcodebuild).
